profiles.coverage_note: Coarse Maharashtra screening envelope. AOIs near a state border require an authoritative boundary check before investment use.

capex.label: Grid-connected rooftop solar benchmark
capex.source_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
capex.source_document: Benchmark costs for Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plants for the Year 2019-20
capex.geographic_scope: States other than MNRE special-category states
capex.inclusions: Total system cost, installation, commissioning, transportation, insurance, five-year AMC/CMC, applicable fees and taxes.
capex.caveat: This is the latest grid-connected rooftop benchmark published on the MNRE benchmark-cost page, but it is historical and is not a vendor quote.

energy_value.label: LT-II commercial energy charge plus wheeling charge
energy_value.source_agency: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Government of India; compiled from MERC tariff orders
energy_value.source_document: Electricity Tariff & Duty and Average Rates of Electricity Supply in India
energy_value.caveat: PV capacity is used only as a screening proxy for the tariff load band. Confirm the actual sanctioned load, consumer category, demand charges, taxes and net-metering treatment with the DISCOM.
